facts.fact: Prime Minister Sifi Ghrieb presided over the official launch on 9 February 2026 of the national data governance framework (dispositif national de gouvernance des données), set up by Presidential Decree 25-320 of 30 December 2025.
facts.system: Dispositif national de gouvernance des données

facts.fact: At the 9 February 2026 launch the High Commissioner for Digitalisation installed the national commission charged with following the framework's implementation, made up of representatives of all ministries and national bodies; the High Commission for Digitalisation is named as its author.
facts.system: Dispositif national de gouvernance des données
